content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Boise

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—typically a combination of a bachelor's degree and documented hours leading projects. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you verify your qualifications and clarify any questions about your background.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP preparation course. Attend all 35 required contact hours—delivered by active certified practitioners—at times that fit your Boise work schedule. You'll master the PMBOK® Guide framework and exam domains in real time, with direct access to instructors for questions.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training, apply directly to PMI with your education, experience, and course completion documentation. Pay the PMI exam registration fee at that time. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process so you avoid delays and submit a complete, accurate profile.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a testing center or online. On test day, you'll answer 180 questions demonstrating mastery of project management across initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closing.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to keep your PMP active. Pursue PDUs through training, conferences, volunteering, or mentoring in project management. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses so you stay current and competitive in your local job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
